name: values-code-outside-the-target-holds
description: An as expression over an object no file of the target declares, a platform global among them, and a new expression through a construct signature no code of the target implements, hand the target a value code outside it holds, so every member of the target's type that value is given is read. An as expression over a decoded value of type any hands over nothing, so a member the target only writes stays reported.
